description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcel in Wilakatupotha, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420953 and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land registration processes across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which includes land registrations, title claims, and land ownership determinations.
